message.content:
Yes—you can file a noise complaint in Atlanta, but it’s handled through the city’s public‑safety and code‑enforcement offices rather than directly by the city council. Here’s how to do it:

| Step | What to do | Where to go / Who to call |
|------|------------|---------------------------|
| **1. Identify the problem** | Note the time, location, and type of noise (e.g., loud music, construction, barking dogs). | — |
| **2. File an online complaint** | Use the City of Atlanta’s 311 portal. You’ll be asked to describe the issue and provide details. | <https://www.atlantaga.gov/311> |
| **3. Call 311 (non‑emergency)** | If you prefer to speak to someone or need help filling out the form, call 311. | 404‑656‑3111 |
| **4. Contact the Atlanta Police Department (APD)** | For immediate or urgent noise issues (e.g., ongoing disturbance), you can call the APD non‑emergency line. | 404‑656‑3111 |
| **5. Reach out to the City’s Code Enforcement** | If the noise violates a city ordinance (e.g., after‑hours construction), the Code Enforcement Division will investigate. | 404‑656‑3111 (same line as 311) |
| **6. Follow up** | You’ll receive a reference number. Keep it handy if you need to check status or provide additional information. | — |

### Quick links

* **City of Atlanta – 311**: <https://www.atlantaga.gov/311>
* **Noise Ordinance (City of Atlanta)**: <https://www.atlantaga.gov/government/departments/department-of-public-safety/department-of-public-safety-division-of-traffic-and-transportation/noise-ordinance>
* **Atlanta Police Department – Non‑Emergency**: 404‑656‑3111

### Why the city council isn’t the first point of contact

The city council’s role is to pass ordinances and oversee city departments. Noise complaints are typically routed to the **Department of Public Safety** (police) or the **Code Enforcement Division**. If you feel the council should intervene—perhaps because a recurring issue isn’t being addressed—you can contact your local council member after the complaint has been filed. They can raise the issue in council meetings or work with the relevant departments to enforce the ordinance.

---

**Bottom line:** Yes, you can report a noise complaint in Atlanta. Use the 311 system or call the non‑emergency line, and the city’s public‑safety or code‑enforcement teams will take it from there.
